items.title: Azurean reaches its first-stone milestone
items.summary: Azur Group marked the first stone for Azurean Marbella, a planned €100 million development of 133 residences under Destination by Hyatt. Delivery is targeted for 2029. Owners may participate in professional hotel operations during permitted periods; income depends on operating results and programme terms. This milestone does not establish completed delivery or guaranteed returns.
items.status: First stone marked · Delivery targeted for 2029
items.source: Azur Group release · MN Comunicación · 20 November 2026

items.title: Marbella’s new PGOM takes effect
items.summary: Marbella’s general municipal planning framework took effect on 14 November, following publication of its urban-planning rules in Málaga’s provincial gazette on 13 November. Definitively approved on 18 September, the PGOM sets territorial strategy and land classification. Its commencement is a municipal planning milestone; individual development rights and licences still require property-specific verification.
items.source: Marbella Town Hall · Report dated 13 November 2026

items.title: Ratified housing decree sets December VAT change
items.summary: Ratification of RDL 29/2026 was published on 13 November. Its rental VAT changes take effect on 1 December: furnished accommodation rented to the same tenant for no more than 30 nights becomes subject to 10% VAT, with an exception for the landlord’s habitual residence. Hotel-service rentals remain taxable; contract circumstances determine treatment.
items.status: Decree ratified · VAT change effective 1 December 2026
items.figureLabel: VAT rate for qualifying short stays

items.title: Rental renewal decree repealed before commencement
items.summary: The BOE published Parliament’s repeal of RDL 28/2026 on 13 November, following the vote on 12 November. Its new five- or seven-year renewal regime and related landlord compensation provisions did not take effect on the planned 15 November commencement date. The repeal does not remove other applicable lease rules or tenant protections.
items.status: Repeal published · No commencement on 15 November

items.title: A fresh snapshot of luxury asking prices
items.summary: Drumelia’s dated 21 November snapshot covers 769 homes and plots, including 745 publicly priced listings with a €3.495 million median asking price. Its 456 villas have a €4.75 million median. These figures describe one agency’s advertised inventory across several locations, not completed transactions, the whole market or a measured weekly price change.
items.status: Agency inventory snapshot · Asking prices, not completions
